label: Framing
description: Compositional structure — how the frame is organized and where it sends the eye.

items.name: rule-of-thirds
items.text: composed on the rule of thirds, the subject seated on a power point with directional space opening ahead of it

items.name: central-symmetry
items.text: dead-center symmetrical composition, the two halves of the frame mirroring within a hair, formal, frontal and confrontational

items.name: negative-space
items.text: vast empty negative space dwarfing one small, precisely placed subject, the emptiness itself carrying the composition

items.name: leading-lines
items.text: strong leading lines — road edges, rails, cables — converging from the frame corners onto the subject

items.name: golden-spiral
items.text: golden-spiral composition, the eye swept along a natural curl of elements to land exactly on the focal point

items.name: frame-in-frame
items.text: a frame within the frame, the subject enclosed by arch, window or overhanging branches, the inner border held a stop darker so the eye funnels inward

items.name: diagonal-energy
items.text: aggressive diagonal composition, the main mass running corner to corner so the frame never settles

items.name: layered-depth
items.text: three distinct planes, foreground anchor, midground subject, atmospheric background, each a step lighter and softer than the last

items.name: pattern-break
items.text: a repeating pattern filling the frame — windows, columns, waves — broken by a single interrupting subject the eye snaps to

items.name: horizon-low
items.text: horizon pinned in the lowest quarter of the frame, the sky claiming everything above and tipping the scale toward atmosphere

items.name: horizon-high
items.text: horizon pinned in the highest quarter, the foreground ground plane unrolling toward the viewer in deep textured perspective

items.name: tight-crop
items.text: aggressively tight crop slicing into the subject at the frame edges, claustrophobic immediacy with nowhere for the eye to leave

items.name: one-point-perspective
items.text: strict one-point perspective, every line of the space converging on a single vanishing point behind the subject, corridor symmetry pulling the eye in

items.name: triangle-composition
items.text: elements arranged in a stable triangle, the broad base grounding the frame while the apex carries the key detail

items.name: gaze-room
items.text: subject placed off-center with open space in the direction of the gaze, the look given room to land

items.name: scale-contrast
items.text: scale contrast, one tiny figure set against a single colossal element so the size gap between them becomes the story of the frame

items.name: radial-composition
items.text: radial composition, spokes, petals or converging streets raying outward from a bright hub that anchors the eye at the center
